# Copilot instructions

The instructions for every coding agent in this repository, Copilot included, live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it before starting any task, and follow its links to the README sections on building and testing.

Don't add instructions to this file. Agent instructions belong in `AGENTS.md`, which Copilot's coding agent and code review also read directly, and agents change it only when a human explicitly asks.
